candidates.summary: the new nested module joins the ci-dir-misc matrix, which runs the `go fix` check on it, but not the root Makefile's `fix` loop, so the command that check tells contributors to run cannot reach it
candidates.failure_scenario: misc/gnopreview/go.mod makes the directory its own module, and ci-dir-misc.yml:44 adds `gnopreview` to the matrix that calls _ci-go.yml, whose lint job runs `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.1 CGO_ENABLED=1 go fix -omitzero=false -diff ./...` inside misc/gnopreview and, on any output, prints "::error::'go fix' would modify files. Run 'make fix' from the repo root and commit the result." The root Makefile's `fix` recipe covers the root module (`go fix ./...`, which skips nested modules) plus the hardcoded list `$(wildcard contribs/*/) misc/audit-pattern-harness/ misc/autocounterd/ misc/gnoe2e/ misc/loop/`; misc/gnopreview/ is absent from it. The next GO_FIX_TOOLCHAIN bump that makes a modernizer fire on crawl.go, plan.go, main.go, shots.go or comment.go turns the gnopreview lint job red, and `make fix` from the repo root leaves those files untouched, so the contributor follows the error's own instruction, sees no diff, and has to discover the module-local incantation. The Makefile comment two lines above the list states the invariant and records the same incident already happening once: "The misc/ entries must track the ci-dir-misc.yml matrix" and "audit-pattern-harness was linted by CI and missing here, so its CI failure told the reader to run a target that could not fix it." The PR body (line 150) checks the matrix registration and stops there, and its "`go fix` ... clean" claim is what keeps the gap invisible today. Fix: add `misc/gnopreview/` to the loop at Makefile:101.
